THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Creamy Beef Bacon Pasta

Adjusted recipe for 4 servings. Use the ingredient quantities below.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME30 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~350 cal | ~28g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: DICE BACON FIRST. 20 slices Godshall's stacked + cross-cut into 1/2-inch pieces. Faster than slicing one by one. Diced bacon renders faster + distributes evenly across the dish.

Ingredients scaled from the original 6-serving recipe. Cooking times, pan size, and amounts written in the method may need adjustment.

Ingredients

PROTEIN

  • 1 1/3 packs Godshall's Beef Bacon (20 slices total, 10 oz × 2)

ADULT PASTA

  • 2 2/3 servings dry Carbe Diem Penne (~8 oz dry — adult pot)

ADULT FINISH

  • ~46 2/3% of the rendered bacon crumble (kid pot gets the other ~30%)
  • 2/3–1 1/3 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
  • Cracked black pepper

Option 2

  • 1 1/3 servings dry regular wheat penne (Barilla classic or any familiar penne, ~4 oz dry — kid pot)
  • ~1/2 cup Rao's Homemade Alfredo (straight from the jar — NOT the blended sauce)
  • ~20% of the rendered bacon crumble (the rest is for adults)
  • (NO blended sauce, NO parsley)

ADULT BLENDED SAUCE

  • 2/3 container (16 oz) Daisy Low-Fat Cottage Cheese
  • 2 2/3 wedges Laughing Cow Light Spreadable Cheese
  • 2 servings (~3/4 cup) Rao's Homemade Alfredo (for the blend)
  • 1/3 cup Kirkland Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth (half a portion)

Option 1

  • 1 1/3 servings dry regular wheat penne (Barilla classic or any familiar penne, ~4 oz dry — kid pot)
  • ~1/2 cup Rao's Homemade Alfredo (straight from the jar — NOT the blended sauce)
  • ~20% of the rendered bacon crumble (the rest is for adults)
  • (NO blended sauce, NO parsley)

Option 3

  • 1 1/3 servings dry regular wheat penne (Barilla classic or any familiar penne, ~4 oz dry — kid pot)
  • ~1/2 cup Rao's Homemade Alfredo (straight from the jar — NOT the blended sauce)
  • ~20% of the rendered bacon crumble (the rest is for adults)
  • (NO blended sauce, NO parsley)

Allergens: dairy, gluten.

AT THE PASTA POTS. Two pots cook simultaneously (Carbe Diem for adults, regular wheat penne for kids). The bacon is cooked once, then split — ~70% into the adult pot, ~30% into the kid pot. The blended sauce goes ONLY into the adult pot. The kid pot gets plain Rao's Alfredo straight from the jar + their bacon share. Bacon is on BOTH plates; the split-cook lever is the sauce + the pasta.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.PREP. Dice 20 slices Godshall's Beef Bacon (stack + cross-cut into 1/2-inch pieces). Set two pots of salted water to boil. Chop a small handful of parsley for the adult plate.
  2. 2.RENDER BACON. Diced bacon into a wide skillet over medium-high heat. 6-8 min until crisp. Pour into a strainer set over a bowl. Discard most of the rendered fat (reserve 1 tbsp in the pan if you want).
  3. 3.BLEND THE ADULT SAUCE (cold/warm, NOT hot). Food processor — full tub Daisy cottage cheese + 4 Laughing Cow Light wedges + 3 servings (~3/4 cup) Rao's Alfredo + 1/2 cup Kirkland bone broth. Blend 60 sec until completely smooth.
  4. 4.COOK TWO PASTAS SIMULTANEOUSLY. Pot 1: 4 servings dry Carbe Diem Penne (adult, ~8 oz dry). Pot 2: 2 servings dry regular wheat penne (kid, ~4 oz dry). Both 9-10 min al dente.

Adult — Carbe Diem + Blended Sauce + Beef Bacon

  1. 5.ADULT BUILD. Drained Carbe Diem back into its pot OFF heat. Pour in the blended sauce. Return to LOW heat. Stir 60 sec — should coat the back of a spoon, not slide off. Fold in ~70% of the crispy bacon (save ~30% for the kid pot).
  2. 6.PLATE ADULT. Wide bowl. Generous scoop. Sprinkle chopped parsley + cracked black pepper.

Kid — Regular Penne + Plain Alfredo + Bacon · Option 1

  1. 5.KID POT. Drained regular penne back into its pot OFF heat. Stir in ~3/4 cup Rao's Alfredo straight from the jar. Fold in the kid's share of the bacon (~30% of the rendered crumble — leave the pieces a touch larger if the kid prefers visible bacon).
  2. 6.PLATE KID. Smaller bowl or plate. Penne + Alfredo + visible bacon chunks. No parsley, no blended sauce.

Kid — Regular Penne + Plain Alfredo + Bacon · Option 2

  1. 5.Skip the Alfredo entirely. Toss the drained penne with 1 tbsp butter + a pinch of salt + 1 tbsp grated Parmesan + the kid's bacon share. Universal plain-pasta-plus-bacon override.

Kid — Regular Penne + Plain Alfredo + Bacon · Option 3

  1. 5.Toss kid pasta with plain Rao's only (no bacon mixed in). Plate the bacon share in a small ramekin alongside the pasta — visible-separate option for kids who eat one thing at a time.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Carbe Diem + Blended Sauce + Beef Bacon: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Regular Penne + Plain Alfredo + Bacon: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • RENDER CRISPY, THEN DRAIN. Medium-high heat in a wide skillet, 6-8 min until crisp. Pour into a strainer over a bowl. Reserve ~1 tbsp rendered fat in the pan (everything else: discard).
  • BLEND COLD/WARM, NOT HOT. In a food processor: full tub Daisy cottage cheese + 4 Laughing Cow Light wedges + 3 servings (~3/4 cup) Rao's Alfredo + 1/2 cup Kirkland bone broth. Blend until completely smooth, 60 sec. If thick, add 2 tbsp more broth.

If something fails

Sauce broke / went grainy: You blended it hot or added it to a hot pan over high heat. Cottage cheese curdles past a gentle simmer. Blend cold/warm in the processor first; combine with pasta over LOW heat only. If broken: blend in 1 tbsp cream cheese + 1 tbsp warm bone broth to re-emulsify.

Sauce is oily / glossy in the wrong way: You skipped the bacon-fat drain. Spoon visible fat off the top + stir in 1 tbsp Laughing Cow to re-emulsify. Next time: drain the strainer, reserve only 1 tbsp fat.

Kid wouldn't touch the Carbe Diem: Most kids reject protein pasta on first sight. Use regular wheat penne for kids — Barilla mini penne, Ronzoni, whatever's familiar. Cook in a separate pot.

Adult sauce too thin / drowns the pasta: Blender liquid ratio off. Add 1 more Laughing Cow wedge + blend; or stir in 2 tbsp grated Parmesan on the stove over LOW heat (don't boil).

Pasta dried out by day 2-3 of leftovers: Carbe Diem absorbs sauce overnight more aggressively than wheat pasta. Reheat with a splash of bone broth (2 tbsp per portion), microwave covered 90 sec, stir, 30 more sec.

Macros came in higher than 350 cal: Most likely cause: you didn't drain the bacon fat (adds ~50 cal/serving) or you used 6+ Laughing Cow wedges instead of 4. The blend ratio is the macro budget.

Storage and reheating

Store: 6 containers, fridge. Pete's-style protein pastas absorb sauce overnight — same here for Carbe Diem. Store with a spoonful of extra sauce or 1 tbsp bone broth on top of each portion to preserve creaminess.

Reheat: Microwave covered 90 sec + a 2 tbsp splash of chicken bone broth or water to loosen, stir, 30 more sec. Skip the broth splash and the dish goes chalky by day 3. Stovetop reheat (low heat + bone broth splash + stir) preserves texture best — microwave is acceptable.

Lasts: 3-4 days in the fridge. The kid pasta (plain wheat + Rao's) holds 2-3 days; Carbe Diem + blended sauce holds 4 days as long as bacon fat was drained. Freezes OK 2 months but Carbe Diem texture softens slightly after thaw; best fresh through day 3.

Split Cook Method™Core SignaturesThe Comfort Pasta That Doesn't Look Like Diet Food

Creamy Beef Bacon Pasta

Beef bacon is the pork-free unlock. Godshall's wood-smokes beef plate the same way as pork bacon — crispy, smoky, real meat flavor — and it carries the dish without the 'protein pasta with chicken breast' diet-food signal. The blended cream sauce (Daisy cottage cheese + Laughing Cow wedges + Rao's Alfredo + bone broth) cuts heavy-cream calories in half without losing the cream feel. The photos are the proof: it looks like restaurant Alfredo, not chalky diet pasta.

Make this when

You want creamy bacon pasta that adults can hit 28g protein on at 350 cal — without the kids refusing the protein pasta or the cottage-cheese-blended sauce. Adults get Carbe Diem Penne + a blended cream sauce + beef bacon + parsley. Kids get regular wheat penne + plain Rao's Alfredo, no bacon. Same cook, two pastas, two sauce paths.

Brands I use

Godshall's
Real Wood Smoked Cured Beef Bacon Plates Sliced (10 oz / ~10 slices, buy 2 packs = 20 slices)
Beef-belly cured + naturally wood-smoked the same way as pork bacon — crispy edges, real meaty flavor. 4g protein per slice. 0 carbs. The unlock for pork-free households who still want bacon pasta. Cross-recipe candidate.
Carbe Diem
Penne (12 oz / 340g box — 110 cal / 8g protein / 14g net carbs per 2 oz dry serving)
100% wheat-based but with vital wheat gluten added back + modified wheat starch for fiber — 55% less net carbs than leading penne, plus higher protein. The macro lever that lets the dish carry full-fat Rao's Alfredo in the blend. DO NOT sub regular wheat penne on the adult side; the carb budget breaks.
Daisy
Low-Fat Cottage Cheese (16 oz tub — 1 container per recipe batch)
The Alfredo dilution lever — full tub blends into a creamy base that drops the sauce's per-serving calories without losing the cream feel. Cross-recipe with id 2 (tri-tip penne), id 30 (steak noodles), id 33 (buffalo wings crema).
Laughing Cow
Light Spreadable Cheese Wedges (4 wedges = 100 cal / 8g protein)
Adds creaminess + emulsifies the cottage-cheese blend without the fat cost of cream cheese. Cross-recipe with id 39 (pork chops cowboy butter).
Rao's
Homemade Alfredo Sauce (15 oz jar — used in BOTH the adult blend AND the kid plain pasta)
Real cream + Parmesan + butter, no flour thickener. 3 servings (~3/4 cup) go into the adult blend; another 3/4 cup goes straight onto the kid pasta. One jar serves both lanes. Cross-recipe with id 36 (sausage spinach pasta), id 1 (gnocchi).
Kirkland Signature
Organic Chicken Sipping Bone Broth (8.45 fl oz pouches — use half a pouch for the blend)
Bone broth in the blender thins the sauce so it coats without drowning, plus adds 5g protein from the half portion (free macro win). Cross-recipe across rice bowls (id 24), stir-fries (id 4), steak noodles (id 30), pork lettuce wraps (id 38), pork chops (id 39).
